idPrefix.description: Card id prefix (APP -> APP-12). Default: initials of the repo name, e.g. my-app -> MA.

baseBranch.description: Branch that tasks merge into and gates diff against. Default: origin's HEAD, else main.

wipLimit.description: Maximum cards in in-progress, code-review and ux-review at once (wf claim). Env WF_WIP overrides.

timezone.description: IANA zone for card dates (created, started, done). Default: the system zone.

push.description: Whether finishing a task pushes. Default false: pushing is an explicit project choice.

label.description: Name of the goal that cards with milestone: true count toward (board progress bar, ETA, wf stats).

gates.description: Quality gates for wf gates. All selected gates run in parallel.

cmd.description: Shell command, run with bash -c from the worktree root. Env: WF_BASE (diff base), WF_CHANGED (file listing changed paths).

when.description: Globs matched against changed files; the gate is skipped when none match. '*' crosses directories, '?' is one character, a trailing '/' means everything under it. Omit to always run.

fix.description: Command that fixes what the gate checks (formatters); run by wf gates --fix before the gates.

cache.description: Skip when the content of the 'when' paths (whole tree without 'when') and the command match the last PASS.

cwd.description: Directory (relative to the worktree root) the gate runs in. For monorepos: one gate per package.

timeout.description: Seconds before the gate is killed and reported TIMEOUT (red).

pending.description: Tool not installed yet (fresh project). Reports PENDING (not proven) instead of failing; wf doctor lists it.

release.description: Included in wf gates --release (the full pre-merge gate). false = fast-loop only.

rerun.description: Evidence-based single rerun for a known flake. The rerun is named in the result.

when.description: Regex matched against the gate output; only then is one rerun allowed.

heavy.description: CPU-heavy (tests, build, typecheck): counted against gatesJobs.

gatesCache.description: Global switch for the gate cache (stored in <git common dir>/workflow-gates-cache).

gatesTailLines.description: Lines of output shown per failing gate.

worktree.description: How wf wt-init makes a fresh git worktree runnable.

link.description: Dirs hardlink-copied from the main checkout (symlink fallback), e.g. node_modules, vendor.

copy.description: Files copied once when missing, e.g. .env.

setup.description: Commands run in the worktree after linking, in order.

cache.description: Build/analysis cache dirs copied copy-on-write (cp --reflink=auto) from the main checkout at create: .next/cache, node_modules/.cache, .phpstan-cache, target/.

env.description: Env written to the worktree's .workflow/env; {id}, {slug}, {port} expand. E.g. DB_DATABASE=app_{slug}, CARGO_TARGET_DIR shared.

pool.description: Reusable worktrees kept warm (reset to base) instead of create/destroy per card. 0 = off.

teardown.description: Commands run in the worktree before it is removed (wf finish, wf prune --apply, runner). {id} {slug} {port} expand, e.g. dropdb --if-exists app_{slug}. Leave nothing behind.

ui.description: Whether the project has a UI. false makes the verifier use the nearest non-UI surface and the ux-critic skip.

dev.description: The LOCAL dev app the verifier and ux-critic drive.

url.description: Base URL of the running dev app.

login.description: How to sign in locally: seeded accounts and WHERE the dev credentials live (never the secret itself), or how to register a throwaway account.

check.description: Optional project command for cheap one-shot page checks, preferred over browser MCP steps.

loginFlow.description: wf flow file that signs in; wf shots and wf check --auth reuse its storage state.

docs.description: Docs agents treat as ground truth.

design.description: Design specs and briefs for the ux-critic.

spec.description: Product or build specs for the planner.

standards.description: Engineering and UI/UX standards every agent follows (seeded by plan-project).

high.description: Paths that make a diff high risk (two reviews, owner review).

overnight.description: Unattended runner (wf night / wf run). Env vars of the same name in upper case override.

retries.description: Attempts per card; usage-limit waits and overload backoffs do not count.

model.description: Model for the headless manager sessions; a queue file's '# model:' line overrides.

permissionFlags.description: Permission flags passed to claude -p. Prefer auto mode; --dangerously-skip-permissions only in a disposable sandbox.

exclude.description: Card tags (in the card's tags: list) the runner never picks up.

finish.description: How wf finish lands a task.

mode.description: pr: push the task branch and open a PR (never touches the main checkout). merge: merge into baseBranch under the lock (only when the main checkout is not served or shared). none: leave the branch.

autoMerge.description: pr mode: merge the PR after wf gates --release is green. Never for high risk.

cleanup.description: Remove the task worktree and local branch once landed.

tracker.description: External issue tracker the cards mirror.

requireLink.description: wf new refuses a card without a #issue link.

onMerge.description: Command run on landing with $WF_ISSUE set, e.g. moving the issue to Verifying.

release.description: The full gate that authorizes a merge.

cmd.description: Project CI command (e.g. make ci). Empty: wf gates --release runs every gate with release != false, uncached.

minPasses.description: Minimum review rounds at every risk level; fix commits are always re-reviewed as their own diff.

maxRounds.description: After this many rounds, remaining minor findings become cards instead of another round.

extraAgents.description: Extra agents per risk level, e.g. {"high": ["security"]}.

ownerHoldHigh.description: High-risk tasks stop in owner-review before landing.

widestLocale.description: Locale with the longest strings; visual checks run in it and abort if the page is in another.

localeDir.description: Directory of JSON locale catalogs for wf lang (auto-detected when omitted).

models.description: Model per agent role, overriding the agent frontmatter. Keys: planner, reviewer, ux-critic, implementer, researcher, verifier, mechanic, scout.

testAffected.description: wf test-affected: map changed source globs to the tests to run in the inner loop.

cmd.description: Test command; {files} is replaced by the selected test files.

tests.description: Template; {name} is the source basename without extension.

gatesJobs.description: Max heavy gates running at once (0 = CPU count / 2). Light gates are never queued.

gatesCacheKeys.description: Cache entries kept per gate, so parallel worktrees do not evict each other.

skipFor.description: Card sizes that skip the planner (the manager writes the brief).
